environment.description: Same Ktor microservice on EKS in private subnet. IAM role identical (broad s3:CopyObject). However, the VPC's S3 gateway endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) has a custom endpoint policy with a condition-key restriction: the policy uses aws:ResourceAccount to limit requests and includes an explicit Deny for any s3:CopyObject where the destination does not match a specific resource pattern. The endpoint policy statement uses StringNotEquals on s3:prefix combined with a ResourceArn condition restricting CopyObject destination to arn:aws:s3:::internal-processed-data/* only. Additionally, the endpoint policy includes a secondary condition using aws:PrincipalOrgID to scope access, but the critical control is the resource-level Deny on CopyObject to non-approved destination buckets at the VPC endpoint layer.

config.iam_role_policy: Allow s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, s3:CopyObject on arn:aws:s3:::* for the task role
config.network: All S3 traffic routes through vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 (no internet gateway, no NAT for S3)
